reviews.title: Correct TextField, Font and NetStream conformance boundaries (T-333)
reviews.summary: Demotes declarations whose tests prove a useful subset rather than full Adobe behavior: TextField event sourcing, device-font glyph inspection, NetStream live/adaptive playback, reset-message aggregation, progressive transfer bytes, exact FPS and positive receiveVideoFPS throttling. Other tested text/media declarations remain Working.

entries.note: The non-bubbling host/user transition helper is tested; no real mobile or context-menu user route currently changes the interaction mode.
Embedded SFNT/TTC/WOFF1 cmap paths are exact; device or unresolved fonts use a printable-scalar fallback instead of inspecting installed glyph coverage.
Local file/progressive clips and reset 0–3 playlist behavior are tested; reset 2/3 message aggregation and live/FMS streaming are missing.
Local NetStreamPlayOptions start/length/transition mapping is tested; FMS/RTMP adaptive stream and bitrate switching are missing.
Embedded byte counts are exact; progressive browser playback estimates loaded bytes from buffered time/ready state rather than observed transfer bytes.
Measured/fallback zero and nonzero behavior is tested; exact numeric delivered-frame-rate conformance is not established.
Zero retains the last frame and gates delivery, and positive values resume; positive-rate decoded-frame throttling is missing.
